title: Retool pricing - Free up to 5 users, then $10-$50 per standard user/month
clean_text: Retool's Free tier supports up to 5 Standard Users (builders) and 5 End Users with core database/API integrations and pre-built components. The Team plan is $10 per Standard User per month (annual billing) and adds version history, audit logs, and 3 deployment environments. The Business plan is $50/user/month and adds SSO/SAML, role-based access control, Git source control integration, and custom component development. Enterprise pricing is custom and required for self-hosted deployment as of 2026 (self-hosting is no longer available on lower tiers).
